tools.description: Check that this server can reach a target's Temporal server and namespace, and its codec server if it decodes payloads with one.

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

tools.name: check_connection

tools.description: Count a target's workflow runs that match a Visibility query (every run without one), and with group_by, how many have each value of that search attribute. Counts are approximate.

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

query.description: a Visibility query, such as WorkflowType = 'OrderWorkflow'; omit it for every run

group_by.description: a search attribute whose values to group the count by; Temporal currently groups only by ExecutionStatus

tools.name: count_workflows

tools.description: Get the pollers and backlog of up to 50 task queues, with a section in each for every task queue type asked for: up to 100 of the type's pollers, most recently polled first, and poller_count, the number of pollers (complete is false when any section's list of pollers is cut); the approximate backlog count and the age of its oldest task; and the tasks added and dispatched per second, averaged over about the last 30 seconds. These stats are null if the Temporal server does not report them. A task queue that no worker polls and no task was added to gets sections with no pollers and no backlog, not an error. result has an entry for each name in task_queues, in the order given. A name that the Temporal server rejects as invalid, such as one that is too long, gets an error in its entry and no sections, while the other entries are unaffected. Any other error reading a task queue fails the whole call, and its message starts with the task queue's path, such as task_queues[3].

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

task_queues.description: the names of the task queues to get, from 1 to 50

types.description: the task queue types to return a section for in each task queue; every type if omitted

tools.name: get_task_queues

tools.description: Get the events of a workflow run's history, oldest first unless order is newest_first, each with its event_id, event_time, event_type, attributes and links; run_id in the result is the run read. links point to related executions, such as the workflow run a Nexus operation started; read a linked run in another namespace with get_workflows on the target for that namespace (see list_available_targets). event_types (event types, or the category failures: every event type that ends in Failed or TimedOut) and event_range filter the events, and combine. A call can return fewer than limit events, even none, while more events still match: until complete is true, call next_call's tool with its arguments unchanged for the rest.

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

run_id.description: the run ID; the latest run of the workflow if omitted

event_types.description: the event types to return, named as in event_type (such as ActivityTaskFailed), or the category failures (every event type ending in Failed or TimedOut); every event type if omitted

first.description: the lowest event ID to return, in either order; the run's first event if omitted

last.description: the highest event ID to return, in either order; the run's last event if omitted

event_range.description: the event IDs to return, inclusive

limit.description: the most events to return, from 1 to 100

continuation.description: the continuation from the next_call of the previous call

tools.name: get_workflow_history

tools.description: Get the current state of up to 50 workflow runs: for each item of workflows, the run its run_id names, or the workflow's latest run if run_id is omitted. For a closed run, also its result if it completed, or the failure its close event records; a timed-out run has no failure, only status TimedOut. result has an entry for each item of workflows, in the order given. An item that the Temporal server reports not found or invalid, such as an unknown workflow or a malformed run_id, gets an error in its entry and no run, while the other entries are unaffected. Any other error reading an item fails the whole call, and its message starts with the item's path, such as workflows[3].

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

run_id.description: the run ID; the latest run of the workflow if omitted

workflows.description: the workflow runs to get, from 1 to 50

tools.name: get_workflows

run_id.description: the run ID; the latest run of the workflow if omitted

value.description: with handling decoded or passthrough, the payload as JSON; absent if the payload is not JSON, and then encoding and data hold it

encoding.description: with handling omitted, or decoded or passthrough and no value: the payload's encoding, such as json/plain, binary/protobuf or binary/encrypted; an omitted payload's encoding is as stored, so json/plain or json/protobuf means passthrough would show it as JSON

data.description: with handling decoded or passthrough and no value: the payload's bytes in base64; passthrough bytes are as stored, so may be encrypted or compressed

size_bytes.description: with handling omitted: the size in bytes of the payload's data as stored, not counting its metadata

reason.description: with handling omitted, why: payload_handling if this target leaves payloads out of responses, or decode_failed if the payload was not decoded

error.description: with reason decode_failed: why the payload was not decoded, such as that the codec server could not be reached or responded with an HTTP error

tools.description: List the Temporal targets you can read from, and how tool responses show each one's payloads.
tools.name: list_available_targets

payload_handling.description: how tool responses show this target's payloads, such as workflow inputs and results: omit leaves their contents out; passthrough shows them as Temporal stores them, which may be encrypted or compressed; decode shows them as the target's codec server decodes them. Whoever runs this server sets it for each target

tools.description: List the search attributes that a target's Visibility queries can use, with their types. complete is false when the target's custom search attributes cannot be listed.

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

tools.name: list_search_attributes

tools.description: Search a target's workflow runs with a Visibility query (every run without one) and return a page of them. Each run has workflow_id, run_id and the search attributes asked for in fields, which uses the same names as query (see list_search_attributes); one the run lacks is null (HistoryLength, HistorySizeBytes, StateTransitionCount and ExecutionDuration are null until the run closes). For the next page, call next_call's tool with its arguments unchanged.

target.description: the name or an alias of a target

query.description: a Visibility query, such as WorkflowType = 'OrderWorkflow' AND ExecutionStatus = 'Running'; omit it for every run

fields.description: the search attributes to return besides workflow_id and run_id, such as ExecutionStatus or CustomerId; ExecutionDuration is in nanoseconds; WorkflowType, ExecutionStatus, StartTime and CloseTime if omitted

page_size.description: the most runs to return, from 1 to 100

continuation.description: the continuation from the next_call of the previous page

tools.name: search_workflows
